prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
competitors_mentioned: Chicago Bar Association’s Lawyer Referral Service
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” attorney for every car accident claim—the right choice depends on the severity of your injuries, the evidence, and whether the case may need to go to trial.

A practical starting point is the **Chicago Bar Association’s Lawyer Referral Service**. It screens lawyers for experience and can refer you to someone handling auto-accident cases: **312-554-2001**. The initial consultation with a referred lawyer costs **$30**, according to the association. [Chicago Bar Association](https://legalhelp.chicagobar.org/pages/personal-injury)

You can also compare attorneys listed by **Super Lawyers** for Chicago motor-vehicle cases, but treat rankings as one signal—not a guarantee of results. [Chicago car-accident attorney listings](https://attorneys.superlawyers.com/motor-vehicle-accidents/illinois/chicago/)

Before hiring anyone, ask:
- How many car-accident cases like mine have you handled, and who will work on my case?
- What is your contingency fee, and what case costs might I owe?
- Have you taken similar cases to trial?
- What are the strengths and risks of my claim?

Check the lawyer’s standing through the **Illinois Attorney Registration and Disciplinary Commission (ARDC)**, and speak with more than one attorney if you can.
